regime.summary: Policy rate 21.0% after a +100bp hike on 2023-04-04, CPI 36.42% and rising, 6M bill above policy so the curve prices more hikes, rupee weaker. Equities bounced 6% in a month anyway. Past hike and balance-of-payments squeezes were bad for the index, so I stay neutral with low exposure and cheap cash-generative names only.

evidence.quote: Policy rate 21.0%; last MPC decision 2023-04-04: hike (+100bp)
Regime: 6M T-bill minus policy rate +0.96pp (market pricing hikes); CPI rising over 3 months (+8.9pp)
Lesson: read the rate and the rupee, not the politics.

core.thesis: E&P at P/E 2.5 with 9.2% yield and EPS up 50% year on year; dollar-linked earnings help against a weakening rupee. Not chasing: 16.6% below its 252-day high, 3m +2.5%. Evidence is a cheap-P/E base rate that is unconfirmed, so modest weight.
Fertilizer with 17.6% dividend yield and P/E 6.4, below its high by 13.9%; income cushions a hiking phase. EPS fell 20% year on year, so this is a yield holding, not an earnings story.

not_known: No data on IMF programme status, FX reserves, current account or political stability. Next MPC date not given. Float, sponsor behaviour and balance sheets of the picks are not in the pack. ATRL P/E may be distorted by one-offs.
